atomicity.reason: One obligation (publish the cycle's temperature reduction); the three figures are one derived triple and the no-valid-sample sentence is an edge case of the same rule.

comprehensibility.reason: It filters temperature samples on 'a cleared invalid flag', but no requirement in this set defines how a temperature sample acquires that flag - SWREQ_MODULE_MEDIAN_VALIDITY sets it on cell voltage samples only - so the reader must supply a mechanism that does not exist upstream.
comprehensibility.suggestion: Reference or add the requirement that sets the invalid flag on temperature samples (e.g. a sensor plausibility or range check in the acquisition component), or restate the filter in terms of a condition this set does define.

feasibility.reason: A min/max/spread reduction over the temperature samples every 100 ms is trivial and contradicts nothing else stated.

parent_fit.reason: ARCH_THERMAL_STATE_EVALUATOR owns reducing the valid cell temperatures to highest, lowest and spread once per 100 ms cycle; this requirement specifies exactly that reduction.

unambiguity.reason: 'reports the thermal picture as unavailable' names no concrete output, so a reader cannot tell whether the unavailability is a flag on the published figures, a separate signal, or the absence of a publication.
unambiguity.suggestion: Name the concrete output, e.g. 'shall publish the three figures with a validity flag cleared' or 'shall set the thermal-data-unavailable output'.

verifiability.reason: The cycle, the valid-sample filter, the three figures and the empty-set case are all stated, so a constructed sample set yields a single expected published triple.

summary: Faithful refinement of the parent's reduction with the no-valid-sample case handled, but it filters temperature samples by an invalid flag that no upstream requirement in this set ever sets - SWREQ_MODULE_MEDIAN_VALIDITY flags cell voltages only - and 'reports the thermal picture as unavailable' is not a named output.
